description: This file declares functions related to version information and configuration details of the PyTorch ATen library, such as MKL, MKLDNN, OpenMP versions, and CPU capabilities.

methods.name: show_config
methods.description: Returns a detailed string describing the PyTorch configuration.

methods.name: get_mkl_version
methods.description: Retrieves the version string of the MKL library.

methods.name: get_mkldnn_version
methods.description: Retrieves the version string of the MKLDNN library.

methods.name: get_openmp_version
methods.description: Retrieves the version string of the OpenMP library.

methods.name: get_cxx_flags
methods.description: Returns the compilation flags used for the C++ build.

methods.name: get_cpu_capability
methods.description: Provides information about the CPU's capabilities.
